Attribute.description:
An Attribute is a Variable that is associated with certain entities which may have a
Attribute Value for instances of that entity and
is not an ObservationVariable that was record during the execution of a Study.

Attributes are available for the following entities:
* Cultivar see Cultivar Attribute
* Locale see LocaleAttribute
* Germplasm see GermplasmAttribute
* Observation Unit see ObservationUnitAttribute
* Inventory Lot see InventoryLotAttribute

### Phenome Implementation

In phenome attributes are variables associated with a specific entity.

### PRISM Implementation

In PRISM attributes are columns associated with a specific entity.
